post.caption:
Apple Intelligence is officially making its way to China with the upcoming iOS 27.3 release.

According to an announcement posted to Apple's Chinese newsroom website, the rollout begins with an iOS 27.3 beta scheduled for November 4th, setting the stage for a full consumer release planned for December.

The launch marks an important regional milestone as Apple expands its artificial intelligence ecosystem beyond initial launch territories.

slides_text: Apple Intelligence is Expanding to China
slides_body: The company confirmed its smart software suite will debut for Chinese users with the upcoming iOS 27.3 update.

post.caption:
OpenAI has officially crossed the $1.25 trillion mark.

According to Bloomberg, the company has secured an additional $11 billion in a new funding round. The fresh capital catapults OpenAI into the ranks of the most valuable companies on the planet.

This rapid growth follows an enormous funding round in March, where the firm raised $122 billion at an $852 billion valuation. The milestone arrives as momentum builds across the generative AI sector, with rival Anthropic reportedly nearing an IPO.

#OpenAI #ArtificialIntelligence #TechNews #GenerativeAI #VentureCapital #TechValuation

📰 Source: AI | The Verge (by Stevie Bonifield) - https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1029380/openai-1-25-trillion-investment-valuation
post.headline: OpenAI Reaches Historic $1.25 Trillion Valuation
slides_body: A massive new funding round elevates OpenAI into the ranks of the worlds most valuable companies.
Bloomberg reports that OpenAI secured an additional eleven billion dollars in fresh capital during its latest round.
The surge follows a March round where investors poured in one hundred twenty-two billion dollars.
The valuation benchmark arrives as chief rival Anthropic reportedly prepares for its own public market debut.
